Selenium and pytest: live reports

Reports from the latest CI run on the main branch, one per browser. Each lists every test with its result and time. Expected failures are the known defects of the site.

Chrome report

All 104 tests in headless Chrome, including the screen-size checks.

Firefox report

The same tests in headless Firefox; the screen-size checks are skipped on purpose.

Traceability

Which of the 87 manual test cases are automated, and by which tests.

Source code and the test design guide are in the GitHub repository. Part of the SQA portfolio.
